mechanics.claim: The strike near the end of the displacement is a separate damage instance from the terrain-emergence strike, and if pulled through terrain a third strike occurs partway through the airborne duration.
mechanics.quote: '''K'Sante''' strikes them after {{rutngt|0.125}} into the airborne duration to deal {{as|physical damage}}.

mechanics.claim: If the target is pulled through terrain, K'Sante deals the strike damage a second time (base damage doubled as 'Total Physical Damage').
mechanics.quote: {{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|80*2 to 150*2}} {{as|(+ 5% of his '''bonus''' health)}}}}

mechanics.claim: K'Sante's strike at the end of the terrain displacement does not apply his passive mark.
mechanics.quote: K'Sante's''' strike at the end of the displacement when the target is pulled over terrain does not apply {{ais|Dauntless Instinct|K'Sante}} mark.

mechanics.claim: During All Out, K'Sante's basic abilities (Q/W/E) can be cast at no mana cost.
mechanics.quote: modifies his {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} which can be cast at no cost

mechanics.claim: The health threshold reduces current health to the threshold upon entering All Out if above it, and this lost health is not restored when All Out ends.
mechanics.quote: Health lost from gaining the health threshold is '''not''' restored after the effect ends.

mechanics.claim: K'Sante's maximum health and bonus resistances are unaffected by All Out; only current health and base resistances change.
mechanics.quote: '''K'Sante''' retains his {{as|'''maximum''' health}} and '''bonus''' resistances during All Out.

mechanics.claim: The percentage bonus armor penetration from All Out stacks additively with other percentage armor penetration sources.
mechanics.quote: The percentage bonus armor penetration {{tip|stacks additively}} with other sources of percentage armor penetration.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown for All Out starts only after its full effect (the displacement/blink sequence) completes.
K'Sante is restored to 100% max mana upon entering All Out, then it decays to 0 over the buff's duration before the pre-All-Out mana amount is restored.
mechanics.quote: Upon entering ''All Out'', '''K'Sante''' is restored to {{as|100% '''maximum''' mana}}. His {{as|mana}} then decays to {{as|0|mana}} over the duration of the buff
